Streaming chat completion with tool/function call chunks

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    request = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"What's the weather?\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"tools\":[{\"function\":{\"name\":\"get_weather\",\"parameters\":{\"properties\":{\"city\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"type\":\"object\"}},\"type\":\"function\"}]}")
    result = client.chat_stream(request)
    chunks = []
    async for chunk in result:
        chunks.append(chunk)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())

```
